sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that marriage of applicant and respondent was solemnized on 24.05.2013 according to Hindu rites and rituals at District Rewa.
Thereafter from their wedlock a baby boy namely Yash Soni was born on 13.03.2015, who is residing with applicant.

It is submitted that soon after marriage the respondent as well as his family members started to raise a demand of Rs.1,00,000/-, a motorcycle and refrigerator as dowry from applicant's family members.

Since the parents of the applicant are not financially sound, therefore, they were unable to meet out with the illegitimate demand of dowry by the respondent and his family NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:50895 2 MCC-2507-2017 members.
Due to non-fulfillment of demands, the respondent as well as his family members used to harass the applicant and also treated her with cruelty.
It is further submitted that initially applicant has not made any complaint against respondent in respect to save her matrimonial relationship.

However,
when the attitude of the respondent did not change even after long passage of time and once in October, 2014 the applicant was thrown out of her matrimonial house by respondent when she was pregnant, thereafter, applicant filed a petition under Section 125 of Cr.P.C. on 06.03.2017 before the Court of J.M.F.C., Rewa against respondent.

Thereafter, just to harass the applicant, the respondent has moved an application under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act for restitution of conjugal right before First Additional District Judge, Amarpatan, District Satna which is registered as H.M. Case No.11/2017.

sentences.text: It is submitted that it is clear that the life of applicant and her son will put in danger from the respondent if she is compelled to go Amarpatan to attend the case.
The applicant is a woman and she is residing at Village Ratahara, District Rewa.
She has no sufficient fund and it is very difficult to her to manage the expense to attend the case at Amarpatan, District Satna.
There is no male member in the company of applicant who can go along with her and there is also nobody to look after her minor child.
It is further submitted that one case is already pending between the parties NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:50895 3 MCC-2507-2017 before the Court of J.M.F.C. Rewa.
